title: Italian pork sausage, mild, cooked, pan‑fried

content.title: About
content.content: Italian mild pork sausage is a ready‑to‑eat product made from selected pork, seasoned with classic Italian spices such as fennel, garlic and paprika. The sausage is first cooked and then pan‑fried until a golden crust forms, keeping the interior juicy and tender.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Italian sausage has a history of more than 500 years, originating from the Apulia region.
Traditional recipes include wine, which gives the sausage its distinctive aroma.
A mild cook preserves more natural meat juices compared with well‑done varieties.
The sausage is often used in pasta dishes, risotto, and as a pizza topping.
Pan‑frying creates a crisp exterior while the inside remains tender.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Pork provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron supports normal hemoglobin levels and energy metabolism.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The sausage supplies B12, niacin and riboflavin, important for the nervous system and metabolism.

items.title: Beneficial fats
items.content: Pork includes monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that can support heart health when consumed in moderation.

items.title: Zinc source
items.content: Zinc contributes to immune function and wound healing.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: The sausage is often salty; people with hypertension should limit intake.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Pork contains saturated fats that may raise cholesterol levels if eaten excessively.

items.title: Spice allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to spices such as fennel or garlic.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain versions contain nitrites and other preservatives; those sensitive should choose additive‑free products.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the sausage hot, pan‑fried, as a standalone dish, or add it to pasta, risotto, salads, or sandwiches. Garnish with fresh herbs like basil or parsley for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the sausage refrigerated at 0 °C‑4 °C in its original packaging or an airtight container. It lasts up to 7 days after opening. When frozen, it can be stored for up to 3 months; thaw in the refrigerator, not at room temperature.
